text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is up, so treat tonight as a look-from-shore kind of evening. Fog and mist are hanging around now, but skies should break from partly cloudy to clear after sunset at 6:31. North winds will build on the lake to 15 to 25 knots, with waves up to 3 feet, while temperatures slip toward 48. Keep the waterfront plans close to land and add a layer.

Saturday is the payoff, with full sunshine and a high right around 58. It’ll still feel brisk near the water, with north winds around 10 to 15 knots, though waves should settle to a foot or less by later in the day. Good day for a sunny walk or bike ride, but I’d leave the small boats tied up tonight and wait for calmer water Saturday night.
